colony.annocraft1800.campaign_intro: The Valmont Inheritance: nine missions in five chapters. Rebuild your family's company, face the Mist Corsairs, reach the New World and bring down the uncle who betrayed your father. Objectives are measured on the shared colony: every player takes part.
colony.annocraft1800.siege_help: Besiege the chosen island: only against a faction at war with you.
colony.annocraft1800.route_help: The ship shuttles for ever: it loads the "Out" good at the start, unloads it at the end, then brings the "Back" good home.
colony.annocraft1800.route_needs_ports: A route needs two islands with a warehouse (coastal trading post).
colony.annocraft1800.no_trade_war: At war: no trade possible. Offer a ceasefire in Diplomacy.
gamerule.annocraftCompetitive.descriptio: Off: cooperation, every player runs the same colony. On: every player founds their own company (treasury, islands, fleet, diplomacy) and may trade, ally or go to war with the others.
colony.annocraft1800.coop_hint: Cooperative game: every player runs the same colony together (treasury, islands, fleet). To play against each other, create the world with the rule "annocraftCompetitive".

campaign.annocraft1800.arrival.title: Return to the archipelago
campaign.annocraft1800.arrival.text: Welcome home. I am Agnès Morel, your late father's harbourmistress. Your uncle Silas has seized the Valmont Company, and your brother Julien is in prison, accused of the shipwreck that killed your father. We have one ship and its cargo left. Let us found a trading post, house families and feed them: everything starts again here.
campaign.annocraft1800.first_town.title: A real town
campaign.annocraft1800.first_town.text: Families are arriving, but farmers want more than fish: a market to meet at and work clothes for the fields. Give them a real town and they will give you their loyalty... and their taxes.
campaign.annocraft1800.industry.title: The age of chimneys
campaign.annocraft1800.industry.text: Edmund Linnell, engineer and an old friend of your father. The future belongs to workers: sausages, bread, bricks. I will help you build factories, but we need hands and clay. And beware: your uncle is watching your chimneys very closely.
campaign.annocraft1800.fleet.title: Setting sail
campaign.annocraft1800.fleet.text: One island will not be enough. Found a second trading post, build a shipyard, fit out two ships and connect your islands with a trade route. Goods must flow for the colony to grow.
campaign.annocraft1800.pirates.title: The Mist Corsairs
campaign.annocraft1800.pirates.text: Ha! So these are the new masters of the archipelago. These waters are mine, little colony. Pay tribute or sink... unless your cannons speak louder than mine? And if you survive, perhaps I will tell you where the western passage leads.
campaign.annocraft1800.new_world.title: The New World
campaign.annocraft1800.new_world.text: Rook did not lie: to the west lie warm lands where sugar cane, coffee and tobacco grow. Sail there from the Colony menu, found a trading post, settle laborers and bring back rum: your artisans already ask for it.
campaign.annocraft1800.ashby.title: Lady Ashby
campaign.annocraft1800.ashby.text: Lady Margaret Ashby. They say you seek the truth about the shipwreck. As it happens, I hold the logbook of your father's ship. I will only entrust it to a reliable trading partner who rules a true town of artisans.
campaign.annocraft1800.war.title: Commodore Dravek
campaign.annocraft1800.war.text: A letter from Julien, in his cell: "The logbook proves it. Commodore Dravek sank our father's ship on Silas's orders. As long as Dravek holds his fortified island, no court will dare accuse him. Declare war, arm frigates and take his lair."
campaign.annocraft1800.trial.title: The trial
campaign.annocraft1800.trial.text: Dravek has fallen and his confession condemns Silas. The Court still needs convincing: show it a prosperous colony, engineers, investors and sound accounts. Then the Valmont name will be cleared.
campaign.annocraft1800.ending: Silas Valmont has been convicted and Julien is free. The Valmont Company is yours again, from the Old to the New World. The archipelago is yours: keep it prospering. End of the campaign.
